cases.title: Upload a file that isn't a PDF
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose not_a_pdf
expected: A plain message asks for a PDF
No new row appears in the Inbox

cases.title: Upload a password-protected PDF
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose encrypted
expected: A plain message explains it can't be read
No half-created document is left in the Inbox

cases.title: AI step fails: a manual draft still works
preconditions: A test server started WITHOUT a valid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (never the live one)
steps: Add a signer and assign the fields by hand
expected: Review still opens, with every detected blank in "Needs review"
The summary says the AI step failed and fields must be assigned by hand
The document can still be sent and signed

cases.title: Invalid email is refused
expected: "Enter a valid email" shows under the field

cases.title: Autosave survives a refresh mid-edit
steps: Move a field to another signer

cases.title: Tampered or random signing link
steps: Open <app address>/sign/not-a-real-token in a private window
expected: The page says "This signing link is not valid" (no crash, no data shown)

cases.title: Long document
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose long
Time how long until Review opens
Scroll through all pages of the preview
expected: Progress text stays visible the whole time; Review opens (expect up to about 1–2 minutes)
Fields on later pages are found and assigned
cases.notes: Processing runs while you wait; there's no background queue (logged in DECISIONS.md).

cases.title: A new upload never shows a deleted document's pages
steps: Upload A and look at its preview in Review
Go to the Inbox and delete A (click "Delete", then "Delete")
Upload B in the same browser tab
Look at every page of B's preview
expected: Every preview page shows B's content, never A's (even though B may get A's old number)
cases.notes: Regression test for the cached-page bug fixed on 2026-10-04.
